Swoop questions

What is the cheapest Swoop NBN plan?

NBN 25/10 at $54/mo for 6 months, then $69/mo. That is $738 over the first year (checked 8 October 2026).

Does Swoop let you opt out of CGNAT?

Yes, Swoop gives customers a public IP address free on request.

Do you need to give Swoop 30 days notice to cancel?

Yes. Swoop asks for 30 days notice, so you may pay for part of a month after you switch.
